extracted.intended_audience: SBIR/STTR Phase I applicants and small-biotech teams preparing NIH grant submissions (antibacterial therapeutics)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation and revision of a PHS 398 / SBIR Phase I research and commercialization package for developing an antibacterial therapeutic (ADEP/antibiotic combinations), including required attachments, human/animal subject compliance, milestones, and commercialization/IP strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Type (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Type of Application: The response provided on SF 424 (R&R) Cover Page is repeated for reference, as you attach the appropriate sections of the Research Plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the appropriate research plan sections consistent with the declared application type (New, Resubmission, Renewal, Continuation, Revision).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims: the succinct statement of the project goals and what will be accomplished in the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear, measurable aims (e.g., identify best ADEP4/antibiotic combinations; milestones for advancement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Strategy: the substantive description of Significance, Innovation, and Approach for the research plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include Preliminary Studies, detailed experimental approach, rationale, and how aims will be achieved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Human Subjects (Research Plan attachment / PHS 398)
rubrics_metrics.description: Protection of Human Subjects: sections addressing human subjects protections must be attached when applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer human subjects questions on the PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement (e.g., Clinical Trial? Agency-Defined Phase III?). Provide required protections, consent processes, and related documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women and Minorities (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of Women and Minorities: description of plans for inclusion of women and minority subjects in human subjects research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide justification if any groups are to be excluded and describe recruitment plans and analyses by sex/gender and race/ethnicity where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted / Planned Enrollment Table (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Targeted/Planned Enrollment Table: provide the enrollment targets for the study population.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach a completed enrollment table showing numbers/planned accrual by demographic categories if human subjects are involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of Children: indicate whether children are included and provide rationale/plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe protection and recruitment of pediatric subjects per NIH policy if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Vertebrate Animals: provide the Vertebrate Animals section when vertebrate animals are used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include justifications, humane use, study design, and appropriate approvals (IACUC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/Contractual Arrangements (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consortium/Contractual Arrangements: description of relationships with collaborators and contract research organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach letters or agreements that document the scope of collaboration, responsibilities, and budgetary arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters of Support: provide supporting letters from collaborators, consultants, or potential partners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use letters to document available resources, collaborations, and (where appropriate) commercialization interest; reviewers look for evidence of potential commercialization relationships/letters of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan(s) (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource Sharing Plan(s): plans for sharing data, models, materials, or other resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach resource- and data-sharing plans consistent with NIH policy (e.g., data sharing, model organism sharing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix (Research Plan attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix: supporting documents permitted under NIH rules (e.g., figures, protocols), attached as Appendix.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow NIH Appendix policies for allowable materials and format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Application (for Resubmission or Revision only)
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction to Application (for RESUBMISSION or REVISION only): a short statement describing changes made in response to prior review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly summarize revisions and responses to reviewers; italicize or otherwise highlight changes to facilitate re-review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report/Publication List (Research Plan section)
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress Report Publication List: include progress reports and publications as applicable for renewals/progress reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach relevant publications and progress summaries to demonstrate productivity and preliminary data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research (Research Plan section)
rubrics_metrics.description: Select Agent Research: if select agents are used, provide required documentation and approvals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include registration, biosafety, and compliance documentation per NIH/CDC rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan (Research Plan section)
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan: required when multiple PD/PIs are proposed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe roles, governance, and allocation of responsibilities among PD/PIs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion Enrollment Report (Research Plan section)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion Enrollment Report: reporting on enrollment by sex/gender and race/ethnicity across studies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide historic enrollment data as required by NIH forms where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Human Embryonic Stem Cells (HESC) registry requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? If so, list the registration number of the specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry or check the box indicating that one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specific stem cell line registration numbers or indicate intention to use a registered line; follow NIH stem cell policies strictly.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement — Clinical Trial designation
rubrics_metrics.description: Clinical Trial? Agency-Defined Phase III Clinical Trial? Provide Yes/No responses on the cover supplement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly indicate whether the project involves a clinical trial and the phase; this affects applicable policies and required attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior SBIR Phase II Awards limit (company eligibility compliance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Company Commercialization History: Arietis Corporation has not received more than 15 SBIR Phase II awards from the Federal Government during the preceding 5 fiscal years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm company eligibility regarding the number of prior Phase II awards; noncompliance may affect eligibility for further awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR subcontracting/outsourcing limit
rubrics_metrics.description: SBIR limit on outsourced work must be respected — reviewer noted total outsourced work should be below 50% of the budget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document the percent of work subcontracted; keep subcontracting below SBIR program limits (the application reports ~13%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Veterinary Assurance Statement / Animal Use Detail (VAS)
rubrics_metrics.description: VAS must be provided for all animal species used (reviewers noted VAS on use of rats was not provided while use of mice was well-described).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete VAS and animal use descriptions for each species, including justification and welfare safeguards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biohazards and PPE protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Protections for biohazards must be adequately described; reviewers requested additional biohazard and PPE details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include detailed biosafety procedures, PPE, and containment measures consistent with institutional and NIH guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Milestone for advancing candidates to in vivo studies
rubrics_metrics.description: Milestone: Advance 2 ADEP4/antibiotic combinations to in vivo studies. Combinations which effectively sterilize biofilms and stationary populations of S. aureus, and have a rate of resistance development <10^-9 in the hollow fiber model will be advanced.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define objective, quantitative go/no-go criteria (sterilization in vitro and resistance frequency thresholds) to decide advancement to animal studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phase II milestone: PK/PD and in vivo efficacy requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Phase 2 Milestone: Determine the PK of the combined agents, the pharmacodynamic driver of efficacy, and treat a previously incurable biofilm MRSA infection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phase II should deliver in vivo PK parameters, identify PK/PD drivers, and demonstrate efficacy in an implanted tissue cage biofilm model or equivalent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclinical development / pre-IND study package requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Preclinical development: acute and dose-range finding toxicity studies in rats, a 14 day repeated dose toxicity study in rats, PK studies in rats to select human doses, and Ames and chromosomal aberration genotoxicity studies to form the basis for a risk-benefit assessment prior to the pre-IND meeting with the FDA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conduct GLP/non-GLP-appropriate toxicology, genotoxicity, and PK studies sufficient to support a pre-IND discussion with FDA and entry into clinical trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required level of experimental detail for reviewers (ADME/DMPK/toxicity/isolate numbers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers requested detailed information on how many S. aureus isolates will be utilized and additional information regarding in vitro ADME/DMPK/toxicity studies in Aim 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide explicit numbers, experimental design details, and analytic plans for ADME/DMPK and toxicity studies to satisfy reviewer concerns about sufficiency of preliminary data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercialization/partnering evidence for Fast Track acceptability
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers judged it unclear when the applicant could obtain letters of interest, additional funding commitments, and/or resources from the private sector that would enhance commercialization likelihood and therefore considered fast track unacceptable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For Fast Track or commercialization-focused review, supply credible letters of intent, partnership timelines, and documented industry interest; explain realistic timing for obtaining partner commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intellectual Property (IP) Protection
rubrics_metrics.description: Intellectual Property (IP) Protection: describe patents/status; context noted that Bayer's ADEP4 patent has lapsed and IP strategy is relevant to commercialization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document current IP landscape, patentability, freedom-to-operate, and planned IP filings or strategies to protect the technology and attract partners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basis of competition / target indications as commercialization criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: The trend for the basis of competition in this arena will continue to be best performance... performance will be measured by ability to treat complicated SSTI, osteomyelitis, VAP, bacteremia and endocarditis, where there is clearly a need for improvement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define target clinical indications where improved performance over existing therapies would provide competitive advantage; demonstrate performance in relevant preclinical models.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH/Reviewer evaluation themes (Significance, Investigator, Innovation, Approach, Environment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers' comments reference criteria: 'Significance resides in addressing an area of unmet medical need...', 'The outstanding investigator is highly qualified...', 'Strengths... clever, innovative mechanism of action...', and comments on milestones and feasibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address standard reviewer criteria (Significance, Investigator(s), Innovation, Approach, Environment) clearly in the application and in resubmission responses; emphasize qualifications, novelty, and feasibility.
